name: DermaLens Facial Fungal Morphology Prompts

prompt_guide.target: approximately 100-140 SD2.1 content tokens when validated

clinical_label_caution: Angular cheilitis can have Candida, bacterial, irritant or mixed causes. 30 records are HOLD_FOR_DIAGNOSTIC_REVIEW and omitted from loader by default.
leakage_prevention: All 5 related morphological variants share group and split. Generated images inherit prompt split and group ID.
synthetic_limitation: Visual realism and clinical correctness require human review and independent real-image test evaluation.
